round_robin.title: Round Robin Format
round_robin.warmup: 3-minute warm-up on the clock prior to game
round_robin.overtime: No overtime — games end in a tie (2 pts win, 1 pt tie, 0 pts loss)
round_robin.timeouts: No timeouts allowed during round robin play
round_robin.mercy_rule: 5-goal spread in 3rd period initiates run-time clock (resumes stop-time if lead drops < 5)
round_robin.jerseys: Home team wears dark colored jerseys

elimination.title: Playoff / Elimination Format (Semis & Final)
elimination.timeouts: One 30-second timeout per team (regulation or OT)
elimination.overtime: 5-minute sudden-victory 4-on-4 (teams do not change ends; penalties carry over as 4-on-3 / 5-on-3)
elimination.shootout: Best-of-3 simultaneous shootout from centre ice. If tied, 1-shooter sudden death. All roster skaters must shoot before any player shoots twice.
